text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Dashing, sprinting, El is entering the ring!
El Condor Pasa has arrivvvved!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
My dream is to prove I'm the strongest in the world!
I'm gonna become the champion everyone acknowledges!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No time to be moping around~!
No looking back allowed eiiitheeeer!
Let's soar into the wide open skkkyyyy!!!

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
